Marta (FinOps): FYI — morning billing export shows ~$38,921 attributed to project 'shared-nightpool' for 2026-03-11 00:00-04:00 UTC; looks like team labels didn't propagate overnight. billing-bot: Alert: Billing anomaly detected for BA-12345 — sudden concentration in project 'shared-nightpool' (threshold exceeded). Ravi (Billing Ops): Can someone attach the GCP export rows and ledger ids? I want to see whether these are credits or raw usage. Devon (Infra): Pasting link to the export I pulled: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports/BA-12345?file=nightpool-2026-03-11.csv. Quick scan: many rows have label_gpu_team = NULL but label_nightpool_owner = 'shared-nightpool'. Claire (CostOps): Does this line up with the new autoscaler rollout from last week? Ivo (ML Platform): Yes — we pushed autoscaler v2 that sets a fallback label nightpool_owner for preemptible pods so accounting can keep nightly slices isolated. It seems fallback is being used when kubelet metadata fails. Devon (Infra): SQL I ran against billing_export.gcp_costs:

```
SELECT usage_start_time, project_id, invoice_month, label_gpu_team, label_nightpool_owner, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_costs`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03'
  AND DATE(usage_start_time) = '2026-03-11'
  AND (label_gpu_team IS NULL OR label_gpu_team = '')
  AND label_nightpool_owner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY usage_start_time, project_id, invoice_month, label_gpu_team, label_nightpool_owner
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Devon (Infra): Top row: project_id=shared-nightpool, label_nightpool_owner=shared-nightpool, cost=38921.04. Ravi (Billing Ops): Ok — two actions: 1) retro-assign affected ledger rows to teams and generate internal credit memos; 2) stop auto-assigning 'shared-nightpool' as a fallback for unlabeled pods until we patch. Claire (CostOps): Impact on budgets: several customer chargeback dashboards show overconsumption vs committed credits; if we don't reclassify, finance reports will be off. I recommend we reallocate up to $40k pending mapping. Marta (FinOps): Approve reallocation up to $45k pending mapping file and QA. Ivo (ML Platform): I'll open PR to change fallback to explicit value 'unallocated' and add a webhook to reject pods without label_gpu_team. I'll also add an integration test to the autoscaler manifest. Devon (Infra): I'll assemble a CSV with ledger_id, timestamp, approximate original owner (from scheduler logs) and cost. Uploading to GDrive: https://drive.redwood.internal/finance/nightpool-mappings/3123456789.csv Ravi (Billing Ops): Use this template for the credit memo I will send to accounting:

- invoice_ref: 2026-03-11-BA-12345
- affected_ledger_ids: [list]
- proposed_owner: team_name
- amount: numeric
- reason: fallback label applied when pod labels didn't propagate after autoscaler rollout

Ravi (Billing Ops): Opening ticket BILL-4599 to track: assigned to Devon, Ivo, Claire; severity P2. billing-bot: Action logged: ticket BILL-4599 created, watchers: Marta, Ravi, accounting-bot. accounting-bot: Please include final journal entry IDs when complete. Claire (CostOps): Also request a nightly probe/alert: trigger if >$2k lands in 'shared-nightpool' in a 4h window. Marta (FinOps): Good idea. Ivo (ML Platform): PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/ml-platform/patches/PR-799 12 will change fallback + add webhook/test. Devon (Infra): Will include scheduler timestamps to correlate with autoscaler events for mapping. Ravi (Billing Ops): Once mapping verified, I'll run the reallocation script and post journal refs. Marta (FinOps): No objections. Reallocation approved and automation ticket in flight. Closing for now — please post final memo and journal ids here. :thumbsup:
